Monster Corruption
Corrupted monsters gain several enhancements. Their attacks and body size also change.

Immortal
Upon taking fatal damage, HP is locked at 20%, then a total of 40% Max HP is restored in four intervals over 1 second.

Magic Shield
Gain Armor equal to 100% Max HP. Elites with Armor that is neither broken nor full restore Armor equal to 1% Max HP per second, up to 60 times.

Berserk
When HP is at or below 50%, Attack Power increases by 50% and the attack interval decreases by 50%.

Erosion
When attacked, has a 20% chance to reduce healing received by adventurers within 20 meters by 50% for 5 seconds.

Shared Life
Every 5 seconds, heals allied monsters within 4 meters, excluding itself and bosses, for 5% Max HP.

Barrier
Harder to interrupt under normal conditions. Damage taken during Normal Attacks is reduced by 50%.

Ambush
Damage dealt increases by 25%. Cooldown after triggering: 3 seconds.

Poison Fang
After being hit by a monster's Normal Attack, lose 1 HP per second for about 5 seconds.

Bloodthirst
After damaging an adventurer, restores 10% of its own Max HP. Cooldown: 1 second.

Sharp
Attack Power increases by 30% and damage dealt increases by 30%.

Chaos
Start with 18 damage reduction stacks, each granting 5% All Elemental Resistance. Taking damage from an adventurer removes 1 stack.

Lingering Shadow
After a monster hits an adventurer, that adventurer's Dodge Cooldown increases by 50% for 5 seconds.

Severed Pulse
After a monster hits an adventurer, that adventurer's Burst Skill Energy recharge efficiency decreases by 20% for 5 seconds.

Binding
After a monster hits an adventurer, that adventurer's Movement Speed decreases by 20% for 5 seconds.

Unlock Weapons
Each character has several weapons with different styles and abilities. Meet their unlock requirements, then spend ore materials to forge them.
觉醒等级与潜能结晶\n每名角色攻略每一级<color=#FF4040>混沌难度<:
Awakening Level and Potential Crystals
Each character can claim Awakening Crystals from Difficulty Selection after clearing each Chaos Difficulty level. Use Awakening Crystals to increase that character's Awakening Level and gain Awakening Points.

Awakening Talents
Unlocking Awakening Talents depends on your Awakening Level. Increase your Awakening Level to unlock more Awakening Talents.

Awakening Points
After unlocking an Awakening Talent, spend Awakening Points earned from Awakening Levels to activate it before an adventure. Only activated talents take effect during adventures.
